evals.prompt: In apps/web (Vite + TanStack Router, @oppenheimer/design-system-web on Base UI, icons from @oppenheimer/design-system-web/icons), create a settings form with fields for full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push as independent toggles). Validate with the Zod schema from @oppenheimer/shared and show field errors.
evals.expected_output: A React Hook Form component over the shared Zod schema via useZodResolver, laid out with FieldGroup/Field, Switch toggles, FieldError per field, gap-* spacing and brand colour tokens.
expectations: Uses React Hook Form with the resolver wired through useZodResolver, not useState per field or safeParse in the submit handler
Uses FieldGroup and Field components for form layout instead of raw div with space-y
Uses Switch for independent on/off notification toggles (not looping Button with manual active state)
Field validation renders through FieldError, not a hand-styled paragraph
Uses gap-* (e.g. gap-4, gap-6) instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses the brand colour tokens (text-ink-*, bg-surface-*, --status-*) and no raw colours (bg-red-500) or shadcn aliases (text-muted-foreground)
No manual dark: color overrides
Every user-facing string goes through t()

evals.prompt: In apps/web, create a dialog for editing a user profile: the user's avatar at the top, inputs for name and bio, Save/Cancel buttons with icons. The bio can be long, so the dialog must cope with a short viewport. Components come from @oppenheimer/design-system-web (Base UI), icons from @oppenheimer/design-system-web/icons.
evals.expected_output: A Dialog with DialogTitle, DialogBody around the fields, Avatar + AvatarFallback, data-icon on icon buttons with no icon sizing classes, using the render prop for custom triggers.
expectations: Includes DialogTitle for accessibility (visible or with sr-only class)
Wraps the scrolling middle in DialogBody instead of putting overflow-y-auto or max-h-* on DialogContent
Avatar component includes AvatarFallback
Icons on buttons use the data-icon attribute (data-icon="inline-start" or data-icon="inline-end")
No sizing classes on icons inside components (no size-4, w-4, h-4, etc.)
Imports icons from @oppenheimer/design-system-web/icons, not lucide-react or @tabler/icons-react
Uses the Base UI render prop for custom triggers, not asChild
Places the dialog in src/components/<feature>/, not inside the route file

evals.prompt: In apps/web, create a dashboard section with 4 stat cards in a grid. Each card has a title, a large number, a percentage-change badge and a loading skeleton state. The counts come from a TanStack Query hook that may still be loading.
evals.expected_output: Full Card composition, Skeleton while loading, Badge for the change, brand tokens, gap-* spacing, and no number rendered until the query resolves.
expectations: Uses full Card composition with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent (not dumping everything into CardContent)
Uses Skeleton component for loading placeholders instead of custom animate-pulse divs
Uses Badge component for percentage change instead of custom styled spans, with a neutral or status variant rather than secondary/outline
Renders no placeholder or hardcoded number while the query is loading or undefined
Uses the brand colour tokens (text-ink-*, bg-surface-*, --status-*) and no raw colours (bg-green-500) or shadcn aliases (text-muted-foreground)
Uses gap-* instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses size-* when width and height are equal instead of separate w-* h-*
